name: unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> Rc < [T] , A >
rule: The caller must ensure that every element of the slice inside `self` is fully initialized as a valid `T` before calling `assume_init`; calling it on content that is not fully initialized causes immediate undefined behavior.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Rc < [mem::MaybeUninit < T >] , A > { unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> alloc::rc::Rc < [T] , A > }
